profileText: a Senator from Montana; born in Ramsey, Minn., November 18, 1985; graduated St. Paul Academy, St. Paul, Minn., 2004; B.S., United States Naval Academy, Annapolis, Md., 2008; served in the United States Navy SEAL special forces unit; combat veteran of the War in Afghanistan; attained the rank of lieutenant and received the Bronze Star and Purple Heart; aerial firefighter and company founder; elected as a Republican to the United States Senate in 2024 for the term ending January 3, 2031.
